title: Full Place, Missing Home
one_line_summary: Aachu is surrounded by people in a lively cafe, but the place still feels hollow because the person who makes it home is absent.
emotional_hook: The ache is not being alone. It is being with everyone and still feeling that home is one person who is not there.
setup: Aachu sits at a full cafe/friends table, present in the group but slightly late to every laugh, with an unclaimed space beside her.
escalation: Her attention keeps returning to the entrance or the empty beside-space, then the same familiar cafe corner starts feeling empty even while people remain around her.
payoff: Zuv does not come back. The final slide stays on Aachu in the full cafe, realizing that the noise still cannot become safe silence without him.
relationship_truth: Ghar was never the room, cafe, party, or crowd. It was always the person whose absence changes every place.
why_people_will_share: It gives someone a quiet way to say: I can be surrounded by people and still not feel home without you.
rejected_generic_version: A sad girl alone in a cafe with a polished quote about home not being a place.
active_constraints: Zuv must not physically appear in any slide.
No comeback, reunion, silhouette, ghost, memory figure, phone wallpaper, reflection, or photo of Zuv.
The full public setting must remain visible enough to prove Aachu is not physically alone.
Aachu's readable face and specific body behavior must carry the ache.
